title: Harden shared keyed palette lookup contract
description: Tighten the common KeyedPaletteLookup utility under TSK-0105. Its implementation explicitly skips null entries, so constrain TEntry to reference types rather than relying on an unconstrained generic null comparison. Treat a null entries collection as an empty collection so partially-deserialized Unity palette assets do not leak NullReferenceException from otherwise benign lookup APIs. GetUsableKeys also filters blank selected keys before distinct/sort, making its public result contract consistent with the usability predicate used by the concrete palettes. Existing concrete Entry types are reference types and valid behavior for populated palettes is unchanged.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: KeyedPaletteLookup methods now use `where TEntry : class`; null collections are benign, and GetUsableKeys excludes blank keys. Added six direct runtime tests covering null collections, null entries, ordinal/distinct key policy, and duplicate detection. No Unity execution was performed in this harness.
